adaptations.arenaProjectiles: Bounded cosmetic actors on attack start, not a second damage source. Interrupted attack starts may still show a cosmetic missile; native playback is untested.
adaptations.shukaku: Existing independent hero transformation remains; source summon durations 20/30/40 applied to form duration, not a claim of identical original summon mechanics.
adaptations.gaaraTsunamiAndBurial: Existing independent zone adaptations retained; original tsunami uses native Starfall, burial is source trigger-driven. No claim all Gaara techniques are identical to the protected original.
adaptations.karasu: AEbl/ACvs plus isolated Rpsm using native cluster rockets and three original h01U fog units; no new invocation of the imported shared-global sleeping source callback.
adaptations.kuroari: Native three-second stun, delayed source 400/600/800 damage, then puppet sacrifice. Target stays visible; original hides/devours the target.
adaptations.akamaru: Source critical strike at ranks 2/3; native A00J form at rank 3 mapped to independent companion IDs. Original dog-specific tree jump is not imported.
adaptations.sanshouo: Native ensnare and rank-dependent resistance/cleave; transport/cargo abilities not added.
adaptations.arena2TestShortcut: Direct -arena2 without recorded prelim results seeds all occupied heroes for isolated testing; normal campaign admits only prelim winners.
adaptations.scrollDelivery: Both different scrolls must be brought into tower radius 600. Can be held by different teammates; +2 levels and existing 350 gold each, one time.
